      t.project_key,
      t.session_id,
      t.root_turn_id,
      t.request_title,
      coalesce(m.model, '') <> '' AS has_model,
      t.started_at_ms,
      t.completed_at_ms,
      t.duration_ms,

      t.status,

      CASE
  WHEN coalesce(m.model, '') = ''
